summary.intent: Resolve merge conflicts on a stacked PR branch, link PRs #360 and #361 as a native stack, then implement root-detection marker support (spec, error docs, tests, changeset) and open a PR.
summary.outcome: Merge conflicts in error.rs and related files were resolved by keeping both sides, merge pushed, #360/#361 linked as a native stack, root-detection spec/E030 docs updated, tests added and full CI passing after fixing one test, and a PR opened.

repo: Callisto uses git worktrees under .claude/worktrees (e.g. smoke-main) for parallel branch work.
Error codes are documented in docs/errors.md and an error-doc test checks docs against error.rs variants, so adding an error variant requires a matching doc row (e.g. E030).
Workspace behavior criteria live in docs/specs/workspace.json and should be updated alongside behavior changes.
Changesets are required for changes and are added before running the full CI.
Stacked PRs are linked with the `gh stack link` command.
Root detection treats the starting directory as the package root if it contains the marker, so a 'not found' test must start from the repository root rather than inside a package directory.

code.finding: Added unit test for the root marker; the not-found case must start at the repo root because starting inside `rs` makes `rs` itself the package root.
Added CLI init test covering the no-root fallback, using the existing workspace test helper.

workflow: git merge-tree output may only hint at conflicts; additional files (like error.rs) can conflict during the actual merge, so check all conflict markers after merging.
When both sides add a variant at the same spot, keep both; scripting the resolution (Python in /tmp) makes it repeatable and verifiable.
Run the relevant test subsets (model, graph, init) after a merge before pushing, then run full CI before opening the PR.

friction: error.rs conflicted unexpectedly beyond what the earlier merge-tree preview showed, requiring a second resolution pass.
Initial test premise for the root-detection not-found case was wrong and failed full CI, requiring a fix and rerun.
